entries.title: Build volume runs out of space
entries.root_cause: The build volume lacks space for the compiler's assembly output. Increase or free space on the build volume.

entries.title: Compiler exhausts open file limit
entries.root_cause: The build process exhausts its file descriptor limit while GCC reads headers. Raise the per-process descriptor limit.
entries.differs_from_earlier: Like e1, GCC cannot complete compilation due to an exhausted resource, but this run exhausts file descriptors rather than disk space.

entries.title: Mesh bounds assertion fails
entries.root_cause: The bounds calculation returns an incorrect maximum for a negative-coordinate mesh. Correct the bounds calculation.

entries.title: Build volume runs out of space again
entries.root_cause: The build volume lacks space for the compiler's assembly output. Increase or free space on the build volume.
entries.differs_from_earlier: A later build fails in a different translation unit and reports the space error from the assembler; the build directory is again on a full volume.
